sweep.explanation: 24 combinations per capture. SP API has no explicit offset: rowwise replay slices keys to absolute offset+i+1, or i+1 for lost offset, then uses L1 noncausal split-K. Offsets have no effect for causal-off cells, which remain labelled controls. Rowwise is a diagnostic geometry change, not a product fix. Every variant gets its own dense FP32 NumPy specification reference. Native bf16 controls in call cells. Sinks zero is an EXTRA zero-logit zero-value denominator term, not no sink.

decision_forks.single_argument: Only candidate differing in ONE effective suspect, correcting a nominal mismatch on BOTH calls, and consistent with dense expected semantics qualifies as a candidate. Preserve diagnostics, name exact harness defect, append immutable treatment registration/source fingerprint; re-run D window0 with abs(D-A)<=.005, then original full short/8192 exactness before original C calibration/freeze/PPL/margins. No present auto-unblock.
decision_forks.semantic: If standard differs from dense by a named reproducible operation absent in SP, leave kernel unchanged. Append A prime registration naming exact removed op, code boundary, A prime-A cost, same inputs/flags/feeding; gate D vs A prime at .005. Lead chooses reference and calibration DAG. Unknown op cannot be registered as executed.
decision_forks.neither: If neither or multiple inconsistent candidates match, retain RED; no knob selection or tolerance widening.
